summary: Iter-15 (frontend-only) — E2E sync/parity of Slangcart WEB (React SPA at https://slang-commerce.preview.emergentagent.com) against the SHARED external backend at https://network-pay-1.emergent.host. All 14 requested scenarios executed. 13/14 PASS. One real frontend bug: the /cart page + /checkout Order Summary sidebar render each cart line item with a BLANK image tile, generic 'Product' name, and ₹0 per-item price — the aggregate total is still correct and COD checkout still succeeds end-to-end (POST /api/orders/checkout → 200, order redirected to /orders?success=cod). Root cause is that useCart populates cart.items from GET /api/cart which does not return name/image_url/price fields — the client never enriches them, so OrderSummary hits the fallback branches (it.name || 'Product', missing it.image_url, it.price || 0). Backend team gap OR frontend can enrich via /api/products/{id}.

minor.issue: External-backend response for cart items appears to be missing per-item name, image_url and price fields (only product_id + qty), which forces the WEB frontend into a blank-tile / ₹0 fallback in /cart and Order Summary. /api/orders/checkout DOES return full item details (verified: name=Sugar 500gm, price=40, image_url populated). Recommend backend enrich GET /api/cart or frontend hydrate via /api/products/{id}.
Publish live from /admin/onboarding-terms triggers a 400 (as expected per spec 'backend hasn't accepted onboarding_terms yet'). Save (my browser) works. Known limitation per review request.

ui_bugs.issue: Cart line items render as blank thumbnail + generic 'Product' label + ₹0 unit price. Only the aggregate cart.total renders correctly. Users cannot visually confirm what they are buying. Reproduce: add Sugar 500gm to cart → visit /cart → item shows Qty:1 ₹0 with blank tile. Fallbacks fire because cart.items[].name/image_url/price are undefined from GET /api/cart.

Spec says tab order should be Specifications → Highlights → Description → What's in the box → Sold by. Actual PDP for Samsung only exposes 2 top-level tabs: pd-tab-specs (with 10 sub-tabs pd-tab-spec-1..10) and pd-tab-vendor. Missing top-level Highlights, Description and 'What's in the box' tabs. Sugar 500gm PDP only shows pd-tab-vendor (Sold by) which is fine (empty backend fields). But Samsung has rich data yet those top-level tabs are absent. Likely they are conditionally hidden if the specific backend field is empty; verify against spec.

Samsung PDP does not show the Styled Summaries card grid — likely because backend doesn't supply mrp_price/protection/warranty/delivery on this specific product. Not necessarily a bug (spec allows gracefully empty) but worth confirming a Samsung with populated summary_* fields renders correctly.

issues: Empty product tile with only a generic ShoppingBag icon and 'Product' text is visually confusing. Users at COD checkout cannot see WHAT they are placing an order for. This bites the money-flow UX even though checkout succeeds.

action_items: Frontend (HIGH): Fix /cart and /checkout OrderSummary to render product name + image + unit price. Either (a) enrich cart items client-side by fetching /api/products/{id} once per unique product on cart refresh, or (b) ask the backend team to include name/image_url/price in GET /api/cart response (mobile app likely doesn't hit this bug because it may already hydrate).

Frontend (MEDIUM): Confirm ProductDetail DetailsTabs top-level tab order is Specifications → Highlights → Description → What's in the box → Sold by. Currently Samsung PDP only shows Specifications + Sold by. If the tabs are supposed to always render (with an empty state), remove the hide-when-empty guard for the top-level tabs. If they're spec'd hide-when-empty, that's OK.

Backend (informational, out-of-scope for this workspace): (i) Enrich GET /api/cart with name/image/price. (ii) Accept onboarding_terms in PUT /admin/settings so admin Publish live succeeds (currently returns 400 — expected per user note).

No action needed on: admin nav, user login (no admin routes leaked), T&C gate on become-vendor/become-provider, admin/system-wallet Group 1 revenue exclusion, admin/onboarding-terms stable-UID reorder, COD checkout happy path, orders page after COD.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx OrderSummary (lines 125-155): fallback for it.name ("Product"), fallback for it.image_url (icon), and it.price || 0 mask a real data-shape mismatch with GET /api/cart. Recommend a defensive hydration in CartContext.refresh(): after setCart(data), map each item to fetch missing name/image/price from /api/products/{id} once (memoize) — this makes the WEB app match the mobile app behavior for the same shared cart.

Checkout COD path is solid: addr-name/phone/pincode/line1/line2/city/state present, checkout-method-online / checkout-method-cod both there, checkout-pay button text correctly toggles to 'Place COD order · ₹40', POST /api/orders/checkout → 200 with full order body, redirect to /orders?success=cod&order=<id> and the order appears in My orders with status 'placed'. No 'Shipping address missing' regression when all fields are filled.

AdminOnboardingTerms.jsx stable-UID reorder VERIFIED: filled clause 2 with 'STABLEUID_TEST_MARKER_ZQX', clicked ot-vendor-clause-up-2, marker moved to clause-text-1 slot with content INTACT. Add-clause works, Save (my browser) shows success toast, Publish live surfaces expected 400 warning ('backend not accepting onboarding_terms yet').

Bank balance tally has 'OFF-PLATFORM (INFORMATIONAL)' card with Shop ₹0 / Service ₹6 breakdown as spec'd. Net Worth banner explicitly disclaims 'Backend reports ₹-18,655.16 — includes shop+service which we exclude on web' — matches the known backend limitation the user flagged.

BecomeVendor.jsx: bv-terms-agree checkbox is disabled BEFORE scrolling the T&C block (verified via :disabled), enables AFTER scrolling bv-terms-scroll container to bottom, and Apply (bv-submit) remains disabled until the form (Shop/GST/PAN/Bank/description) is also filled — matches the 'form valid AND agreed=true' contract. Vendor T&C has 10 clauses (bv-terms-clause-1..10) — aligns with AdminOnboardingTerms.jsx default seed (which also has ot-vendor-clause-1..10). The review spec's mention of '12-clause Vendor Declaration' is likely off-by-two; Provider (bp-terms-clause-1..12) is the one with 12 clauses.

Admin/Vendors, Admin/Products, Admin/Vendor-Applications, Admin/Orders, Admin/Transactions all render with data (9, 10, 4, 8, 106 rows/cards respectively). Zero console errors on admin nav.
Shop /shop renders 6 products including Sugar 500gm and Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra with images + prices. User is not shown admin routes.

rca of the issue: OrderSummary blank-line bug RCA — /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx lines 133-155 iterate cart.items and read it.name, it.image_url, it.price. The CartContext (/app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.jsx line 17-18) does setCart(data) directly from GET /api/cart. The external backend at https://network-pay-1.emergent.host apparently returns cart.items as [{product_id, qty}] without name/image/price. The frontend has fallbacks ('Product', ShoppingBag icon, ₹0) that mask the missing data but produce a poor UX. FIX: in CartContext.jsx refresh(), after setCart, run a Promise.all over unique product_ids to fetch /api/products/{id} and merge {name, image_url, price} into cart.items. Cache in a ref to avoid refetching on every refresh. Alternative: get the backend team to return the enriched shape (same behavior mobile app must already have because mobile presumably shows the item names correctly).
